question: Can a history-disjoint At present/In the past and As of now/At that time bank support a sealed A11/M11 physical reader-loss and output-rescue test?

searched: all is/was capability priors, immutable receipts, and v16 denominator audit
temporal/is-was reader, module, Shapley, and exact effect-game records
active screen claims, AGENT_BOARD, BILIN18_CONNECTION, and canonical temporal dossier
prior_art.known_lessons: Native capability precedes causal outcomes. V13/v14 were preserved capability nulls; v15/v16 passed with strong explicit temporal cues. V16's original 24/32 joint wording was a denominator defect, so v17 registers the correct 12/16 per-panel bar before execution. A stable Shapley credit nominates mediation but does not identify a directed edge.
prior_art.novelty: No v17 bank exists. Sixteen reporter nouns, all target texts, all row IDs, and both target construction surfaces are history-disjoint from v4-v16. This gate opens no causal result or intervention.

frozen_design.measurement: Exactly two native forwards over all 64 rows and both sides. No patch, selected module response, learned direction, causal effect, or v17 intervention outcome is read.

predictions.pred_a_authority_novelty_and_exact_popul: Builder/digests, construction checks, full-history target-text/row-ID/reporter novelty, and the exact 64-row inventory pass.
predictions.pred_b_native_a_panel_capability: Every A1/A2 direction-by-side cell has native accuracy at least .75.
predictions.pred_c_joint_capable_population: Each 16-row A panel has at least 12 rows for which both native base and donor predictions are correct.
predictions.pred_d_no_causal_outcome_access_and_exac: Exactly two native forwards/128 examples, zero interventions/backwards/updates, and no causal outcome access.

decision: A screen freezes the exact jointly capable v17 row IDs for the already-selected A11/M11 physical edge test. A null is immutable and closes v17 without inspecting or repairing any causal outcome; select a separately preregistered cue family instead.
